Kate (Support): heads up — customer 'AcmePay' started seeing 403s on SSO after last night's cert rotation. started ~01:30 UTC.
Aj (Infra): which endpoint is failing? ACS url?
Kate (Support): ACS /saml/consume for tenant acmepay. error is 403 recipient mismatch in our logs. I grabbed the last assertion: 
Kate (Support): ```
HTTP 403 POST /saml/consume
AssertionReceiver: recipient mismatch, expected https://acmepay.prod.redwood.ai/saml/consume, got https://acmepay-edge.example-cdn.net/saml/consume
SNI: acmepay.edge.redwood.ai
TLS cert: CN=acmepay.edge.redwood.ai, SAN=acmepay.edge.redwood.ai
```
Ryan (SE): strange — "got" looks like the CDN origin host. Did we recently change ALPN/SNI routing on the edge?
deploy-bot: cert-rotation: completed for edge pool at 2026-03-17T01:15:00Z
Aj (Infra): I see a cert rollout to edge pool + a config that enabled ALPN-based routing for HTTP/2 multiplexing yesterday. possible SNI mapping collision.
Mari (ProdOps): Customer uses an ACS host which we front with per-tenant ALPN routes. If SNI was reused or wrong cert presented, IdP assertion's Recipient would be rewritten by the CDN host header.
Aj (Infra): can you paste the full Host header from the gateway logs for a failing request?
Kate (Support): ```
Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d
Host: acmepay-edge.example-cdn.net
X-Forwarded-Host: acmepay.prod.redwood.ai
SNI: acme-internal-shared-host
Client-Cert: CN=acmepay.edge.redwood.ai
```
Ryan (SE): Aha — SNI shows acme-internal-shared-host (shared ALPN host). That means TLS handshake used shared SNI, but the Host header was the customer's ACS. Some proxies terminate TLS earlier and then call origin with different URL, causing assertion recipient to be the origin host instead of the ACS canonical host. IdP validates recipient against ACS; mismatch -> 403.
Aj (Infra): reproducing locally: enable ALPN routing + shared SNI -> TLS handshake picks shared cert, gateway forwards Host unchanged -> IDP sees recipient=origin host (edge) while metadata lists prod.redwood.ai.
Mari (ProdOps): root cause = cert rotation + ALPN routing change combined: rotation replaced per-tenant certs with a shared cert on a subset of edge nodes while ALPN SNI mapping wasn't populated for those tenants.
Aj (Infra): mitigation: 1) revert to per-tenant certs on affected nodes or 2) SNI override: ensure the SNI sent upstream matches Host header (override SNI to tenant's ACS) and 3) add a temporary recipient normalization fallback for the IdP for the next 48h.
Kate (Support): can we do hotfix 2) now? customer is blocked.
Aj (Infra): rolling SNI-override to edge nodes in us-east-1 now (1/4). ETA ~12m.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: sni-override-hotfix -> edge-canary-us-east-1
Ryan (SE): also recommend we notify IdP admins for AcmePay — some IdPs are strict about Recipient vs Destination. we'll include repro steps and a flag for them to accept the edge host as a temporary Audience/Recipient.
Kate (Support): noted. I'll open a support ticket and draft the message.
Aj (Infra): canary looks good, no 403s in the last 5 minutes for the canary tenant. starting incremental rollout.
deploy-bot: rollout progress: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% across us-east cluster
Kate (Support): confirmed from AcmePay — SAML log shows successful consumer post. they got in. :tada:
Mari (ProdOps): action items: 
- add a pre-check in cert rotation to verify ALPN/SNI mapping per-tenant
- update our runbook: when enabling ALPN routing, ensure per-tenant SNI entries are provisioned
- create an alert when Recipient != configured ACS host after rotation
Kate (Support): putting these on the postmortem. I'll notify the customer and close the ticket after 24h stability.
Ryan (SE): thanks all. quick note for docs: sample curl to repro (use -k for cert differences):
Ryan (SE): ```
curl -v -H "Host: acmepay.prod.redwood.ai" \
  --resolve acmepay-edge.example-cdn.net:443:203.0.113.12 \
  https://acmepay-edge.example-cdn.net/saml/consume -d @assertion.xml
```
Aj (Infra): nice. I'll add a test for this case to the cert rotation CI.
Kate (Support): closing loop — customer will confirm after 24h. thanks everyone. :heart:
